chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality 378: Holy Dragon Slain, Three Kings Pursue
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen slays a Holy Dragon, sparking island-wide chaos. But the Yecha King, War King, and a Skeleton King ambush him. He must escape before being cornered.
og_title: Ch. 378: Xiao Chen's Holy Dragon Ambush Backfires, Three Kings Give Chase
og_description: Xiao Chen's daring plan works—he slays a Holy Dragon and escapes. But his next move is countered: three kings await. A desperate battle and a gamble with the Combat God Clan.
twitter_title: Xiao Chen's Holy Dragon Island Slaughter and the Three Kings' Ambush
twitter_description: Xiao Chen kills a Holy Dragon, but the Yecha King predicts his next move. Cornered by three kings, he must gamble with the neutral Combat God Clan to survive.
